```yaml
name: Build Linux (No Container)

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      python-version:
        required: true
        type: string
      cuda-version:
        required: true
        type: string
      arch:
        required: true
        type: string
      upload-url:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      upload-assets:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}

      - name: Setup CUDA
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit@v1.3.0
        with:
          cuda: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
          method: network
          sub-packages: '["compiler"]'

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install uv
          uv venv
          source .venv/bin/activate
          uv pip install -e ".[dev]"

      - name: Build wheel
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python setup.py bdist_wheel

      - name: Get wheel location
        id: wheel-location
        run: |
          WHEEL_FILE=$(ls dist/*.whl | head -n 1)
          echo "wheel_path=$WHEEL_FILE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "wheel_name=$(basename $WHEEL_FILE)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Upload wheel artifact
        if: inputs.upload-assets
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: flash-attention-${{ inputs.arch }}-${{ inputs.python-version }}-${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
          path: ${{ steps.wheel-location.outputs.wheel_path }}

      - name: Upload to release
        if: inputs.upload-assets && inputs.upload-url != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          gh release upload ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }} ${{ steps.wheel-location.outputs.wheel_path }} --clobber

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          # Remove flash-attention source
          rm -rf flash-attention
          
          # Remove virtual environment
          rm -rf .venv
          
          # Clear pip cache
          pip cache purge
          
          # Clear uv cache
          uv cache clean
          
          # Remove CUDA toolkit if installed via action (optional, depends on runner setup)
          # Usually self-hosted runners manage CUDA installation, so we might not want to remove it globally
          # But if the action installed it in a specific location, we could clean it up here.
          # For safety, we'll skip global CUDA removal unless specified.
```
